patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Crisp and Freshchat share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Crisp only if your buying job matches “Omnichannel messaging with Hugo AI — Free (2 seats); Mini $45; Essentials $95; Plus $295/w” rather than Freshchat's shape. Choose Freshchat only if your buying job matches “Freshworks live chat — free up to 10 agents; Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79 agent/mo ” rather than Crisp's shape. Workflow advantage: Crisp leans omnichannel-support; Freshchat leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Crisp and Freshchat share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Crisp is Omnichannel messaging with Hugo AI — Free (2 seats); Mini $45; Essentials $95; Plus $295/workspace/mo. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; Freshchat is Freshworks live chat — free up to 10 agents; Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79 agent/mo annual. Primary live-chat; CS secondary..
- Workflow coverage skew: Crisp-leaning omnichannel-support vs Freshchat-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Crisp — Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments; Freshchat — Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary.

Limitations — Crisp: Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments; Extra seats beyond included allotment cost $10/seat/mo on paid plans; Freshchat: Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary; Free plan limited to 10 agents.

Poor-fit cases: Crisp is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Hugo AI usage is credit-metered beyond included plan allotments · Freshchat is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary · Avoid Crisp if you actually need Freshchat's motion (Freshworks live chat — free up to 10 agents; Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
